name: Black Friday Vault
accepts: Software, SaaS and WordPress. No rule against apps, but no App Store app was named among the deals on 18 or 20 Nov 2026.
how_to_submit: Form at https://blackfridayvault.com/launch/ (the /submit path returns 404). The sign-in and create-account panel at the top of that page is for upvoting, saving and commenting; the page does not say an account is needed to submit.
entry_format: Fields in order: product or Black Friday page URL (with a fetch-details button), product name, what it does (70 characters max), product website, deal link, regular price, deal price, billing (per year, per month, lifetime, one-time), deal headline (optional if prices are given), coupon code (optional), starts, ends, description (40 to 800 characters), categories (up to 3), contact email (private), a confirmation checkbox.
rules: Free to list. The site checks the price and the link, then publishes, usually within a day.
The prices must be accurate and the discount real, not a raised regular price.
Text copied from your website or another listing is sent back for a rewrite (as read on 18 Nov 2026).
status_note: 2026 edition with 164 live deals on 20 Nov 2026. The page does not show which listings came through the form.
